props.name: data
props.type: GeoJSON.Geometry | GeoJSON.Feature<GeoJSON.Geometry | null, JsonObject | null> | GeoJSON.FeatureCollection<GeoJSON.Geometry | null, JsonObject | null>

props.name: fitBounds
props.comment: Frame the map around the data. Defaults to true.

props.name: fitPadding
props.comment: Pixels kept free around the fitted box. Defaults to 20.

props.name: maxFitZoom
props.comment: The highest zoom a fit may reach, which also sets a single Point's zoom. Defaults to 18.
